decisions.reason: As a flagship organic line with several models that stayed visible across 2023 and 2024, it likely meets aspiration levels and fits the firm's stated strategic direction, so management would keep it.

Although its website prominence fell from a dedicated page to a general mention, it remains a close-to-core multi-variant snack line in a growing firm, so boundedly rational management would more likely continue observing than withdraw it.

This new organic sausage sits squarely in the firm's established competence base and strategic organic expansion, and with only one year of evidence the firm is likely to use available slack to keep testing it.

A new multi-model organic poultry cold-cut line matches consumer demand for lighter and ingredient-conscious options and shows enough strategic fit that the firm would likely retain it while results are still emerging.

This organic herb-coated salami is close to the core salami business and was given its own page at launch, so despite some niche-variant risk the firm would more likely keep it than reallocate resources immediately.
